0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West, on an eight-game losing streak and 1-4 at home) host the Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East, winners of their last game) in an early-season matchup for both teams. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Jazz won the last meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
